findings.title: Zero DpScale makes prepare fail
findings.message: DisplayObjects and the overlay-size cache key depend on camera (zoom/distance), but the mesh is only rebuilt when objects slice differs. Since DisplayObjects is recomputed each frame, this works, but it allocates and clones the entire object list every frame; for overlays with a zero DpScale, DisplayObjects returns an error (scale<=0) and fails the whole frame.
findings.suggestion: Guard DpScale<=0 by defaulting to 1 before calling DisplayObjects.

findings.title: Hardcoded overlay index count
findings.message: Overlay vertex count is hardcoded to 36 indices per box and computed separately from the mesh builder. It also counts invisible objects that DisplayObjects may later have hidden only if flagged; if box() emits a different index count, draws will be wrong. Coupling is fragile and can corrupt draw ranges.
findings.suggestion: Have buildScene3DMesh return the overlay index count directly instead of recomputing it.
